author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: त्वदादेः सर्वस्य अकर्मणि कर्माकरणे सङ्गः स्नेहो माऽभूत् । तदकरणे प्रत्यवायश्रवणादितिभावः
translation: V. In thee:- means Arjuna and includes every wise person, belonging to any caste or order. In respect of fruits: in respect of desiring fruits, i.e., desiring to obtain Svarga, &c. Tbe purport of the first clause is that the Vedic injunction is only to do the duty; it does not command the entertainment of desires too, since no desire comes under the regulation of rules.
